chunks: And strike for them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people of the city mentioned in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse introduces the parable of the 'People of the City' (Ahl al-Qaryah), traditionally identified as Antioch or Tiberias, where three messengers were sent to a single leader to invite his people to monotheism. The narrative highlights the pattern of rejection by the elite and the subsequent divine punishment, serving as a direct warning to the Quraysh in Mecca for their dismissal of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). This story underscores the Shia emphasis on the unity of the messengers' core message and the inevitability of divine justice against those who reject it.
